title: Comfort Club Maintenance Visits: Grants, Seasons, Inclusions and Expiry
content:
Terms governing maintenance visits under Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements.

**Grants.** Each term grants the tier's tune-up visits per system for every enrolled system, posted as one grant per system, plus the tier's whole-home visits, posted as one whole-home grant with no equipment named. Grants carry the reason "new term" at enrollment and "renewal term" at renewal. Visits are granted only to an agreement in pending or active status.

**Mid-term grants.** A system added mid-term receives that system's full per-term visits with the reason "additional system". A mid-term upgrade grants, with the reason "tier upgrade", the difference between the new and the old tier's per-system visits for each enrolled system and the difference in whole-home visits; a grant is never negative.

**Booking.** A maintenance visit is booked and recorded only while the agreement status is active, and a visit is recorded only when visits remaining are above zero.

**Seasons.** Where a tier grants two visits per system, one is a cooling tune-up performed within the cooling season window and the other a heating tune-up performed within the heating season window. Where it grants one, the member chooses either season. A system receives at most one tune-up per season per term, and two tune-ups on the same system are at least the tier's minimum spacing in calendar days apart.

**Whole-home visits** may be taken on any date in the term and cover the water heater flush, the attic and duct inspection and, where the tier includes the indoor air quality inspection, the indoor air quality check.

**Included at no charge on every tune-up:** the tier's number of standard 1-inch filters, the condensate drain treatment where the tier includes it, and the indoor air quality inspection where the tier includes it.

**No rollover.** Unused visits never roll over. At term end, at lapse and at closure any visits remaining are removed by an expiry entry with the reason "term expiry" or "agreement closed"; no expiry entry is posted when nothing remains.

## Visits granted in a term
The visits granted for a term are the tier's tune-up visits per system multiplied by the number of enrolled systems, plus the tier's whole-home visits.

| Hypothetical agreement | Tune-up visits | Whole-home visits | Total for the term |
|---|---|---|---|
| Comfort Club Gold, 3 systems | 2 for each of 3 systems, so 6 | 0 | 6 |
| Comfort Club Total Home, 2 systems | 2 for each of 2 systems, so 4 | 2 | 6 |
| Comfort Club Basic, 1 system | 1 | 0 | 1 |

## Upgrade grant (hypothetical)
An agreement with two enrolled systems moving mid-term from Comfort Club Basic (1 tune-up per system, no whole-home visit) to Comfort Club Platinum (2 per system, 1 whole-home) receives a tier-upgrade grant of 1 further tune-up for each of the two systems and 1 whole-home visit.

## Points of judgement
- A heating tune-up on a two-visit tier booked outside the heating season window does not fit the season rule.
- A second tune-up on the same system 45 days after the first does not meet a 60-day spacing.
- At lapse with 2 visits remaining, an expiry of 2 visits is posted; with none remaining, no expiry entry is posted.
